text.tspan: 1、两个滤芯供方不同，外观不同，但53C0210P02与(02D1133+53C0210P01)可互换。

1.The two filter elements have different suppliers and diefferent appearance, however, 53C0210P02 and (02D1133 + 53C0210P01 )are interchangeable.
